title: Order checkout · Stock and payment

nodes.title: Product and stock available?

nodes.title: Reserve stock and pay
nodes.summary: Keep the order pending; stock is not yet deducted.
nodes.detail: Reserve stock, then request payment. Confirm or release the reservation based on the result.

nodes.title: Confirm order and stock
nodes.summary: Deduct stock only after payment succeeds.
nodes.detail: Commit the reserved stock and confirm the order after successful payment. Failed payments must not reach this step.

nodes.title: Return validation failure
nodes.summary: No payment or stock changes.
nodes.detail: Return a clear reason for an unavailable product or insufficient stock.

nodes.title: Release stock reservation
nodes.summary: Restore availability after a failed or timed-out payment.
nodes.detail: Release this order’s reservation without committing a deduction. Keep the failure reason for retries or queries.

nodes.title: Check payment status
nodes.summary: Choose cancellation or refund based on the current state.
nodes.detail: Release reservations for unpaid orders; start a refund for paid orders.

nodes.title: Complete cancellation or refund
nodes.summary: Update order and stock after success.
nodes.detail: Keep the original order state if a refund fails so it can be queried and handled later.

nodes.title: Check idempotency key
nodes.summary: Process the same request only once.
nodes.detail: Return an existing result; create a processing record only if none exists.
nodes.output: Existing result or permission to process

nodes.title: Return existing result
nodes.summary: Do not repeat payment or stock deduction.
nodes.detail: A retry queries the same processing record without repeating business changes.
